title: Animal Farm
author: George Orwell
summary: The animals of a run-down farm drive out their drunken owner and set up their own equal society. Slowly the pigs take charge, and the rules get quietly rewritten.
readIf: you want a short, sharp fable about how revolutions can be hijacked.
skipIf: you expect a cuddly talking-animal story, because the tone is grim and the ending bleak.

pairings.reason: The same author's longer, fuller picture of what total control looks like.
Another compact allegory about how fast a fair new order can turn on itself.
Another farm full of talking animals, but gentle, loving and comforting.
